title.zh: 宣布每年7月4日为南拉瑙省特别工作假日及学校停课日，以纪念其建省纪念日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring July 4 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the Province of Lanao Del Sur in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring July 4 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the Province of Lanao Del Sur in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10802_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: July 4 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday and no class day in schools in the Province of Lanao del Sure in commemoration ot its foundation day.
For work performed on a special working holiday, an employee is entitled to his/her regular wage.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
